thread.title: US Stock Futures Sink After Apple's Q1 Revenue Warning

author: MT Newswires
title: US Stock Futures Sink After Apple's Q1 Revenue Warning

organizations.name: december institute for supply management manufacturing

text:
Shutterstock photo US stock futures dropped sharply on Thursday after Apple ( AAPL ) slashed its fiscal Q1 revenue outlook, blaming a slowing Chinese economy.
Oil prices nudged higher, buoyed by a reported drop in December crude exports from Saudi Arabia, with global benchmark Brent crude up 0.97%, and US crude West Texas Intermediate up 0.21% recently.
At 8:15 am ET, the national employment report from Automated Data Processing is expected to come in at 175,000 for December against November's 179,000, according to data compiled by Econoday.
At 8:00 am, forecasters see initial claims for the Dec. 29 week coming in at 217,000 vs 216,000 in the previous week.
At 10 am, Econoday's consensus for the December Institute for Supply Management Manufacturing index is at 57.9 vs November's 59.3. Construction spending is expected to bounce a modest 0.2% for November following a 0.1% decline in the previous report.
Forecasters see total unit vehicle sales for December at 17.3 million annualized rate vs November's 17.4 million.
In equities, shares of Celgene were 31% higher pre-bell after the company agreed to be acquired by Bristol-Myers Squibb ( BMY ) in a cash-and-stock deal.
